title: Fabric and Apparel Science FAS - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: Fabric and Apparel Science FAS - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: The Department of Fabric and Apparel Science (FAS) is part of Lady Irwin College in Delhi, which is affiliated with the University of Delhi. The college holds an A+ NAAC accreditation and ranks 31st in the NIRF rankings. It offers admission enquiries and provides contact details, including a phone number (014836). The department’s operating hours are from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm, and the website indicates no testimonials are currently available. The site is powered by WhiteCode and includes quick links for students and site visitors.
